Nafis Temporary Financial Support Calculator for Emiratis Who Lost Their Job

Enter why you lost your job, your age, your family and any other income to see your monthly support and the total over the maximum period.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Calculate your support

Temporary financial support amounts

BeneficiaryMonthly (AED)
The Emirati who lost their job7,000
Husband or wife, if not working4,500
First child2,400
Second child2,400
Third child1,600
Maximum total (non-working spouse and three children)17,900

Sons qualify until 21 or until they start work, daughters until they marry or start work, up to three children. The programme pays for up to 12 months, but no more than 6 consecutive months. So the most a full family receives over six consecutive months is AED 107,400, and AED 214,800 over 12 months.

Conditions and deductions

The support is for Emiratis aged 18 to 60 who lost a job at a covered private employer or a Central Bank-licensed institution for reasons beyond their control, as the Council determines. You must be able to work and have no source of income. Any income from trade licences or property is deducted, as is any smaller social assistance received by you, your spouse or your child.

Students, those entitled to retirement, national service conscripts and people dismissed for moral reasons or legal violations are excluded, and refusing a suitable job offer ends the right. Some websites mention "12 months within five years", which does not appear on the official page.

Unemployment insurance is a separate federal scheme that pays 60% of the average basic salary of the last 6 months for up to 3 months per claim; see the ILOE calculator. For what your employer owes you, use the final settlement calculator, and for salary support once you are back at work, the Nafis calculator.

Frequently asked questions

How much is Nafis support for Emiratis who lost their job?

AED 7,000 a month for the Emirati who lost their job, 4,500 for a husband or wife who does not work, 2,400 for the first child, the same for the second and 1,600 for the third, with a maximum of three children. A family with a non-working spouse and three children receives AED 17,900 a month before any other income is deducted.

How long does Nafis temporary financial support last?

Up to 12 months under the programme, provided the support does not run for more than 6 consecutive months, according to the programme page in the Nafis Knowledge Centre.

Who is eligible for Nafis temporary support?

An Emirati aged 18 to 60 who lost a job at a covered private employer or a Central Bank-licensed institution for reasons beyond their control, who is able to work and has no source of income. Students, those entitled to retirement, national service conscripts and people dismissed for moral reasons or legal violations are excluded, and refusing a job offer ends the right.

Can Nafis support be combined with unemployment insurance?

They are separate schemes: unemployment insurance (ILOE) pays 60% of the average basic salary for up to three months per claim. Sources do not settle whether ILOE compensation is deducted from Nafis support as income; income from trade licences or property is deducted.
